edits.edit_diff:
--- /linux/fs/nilfs2/btree.c
+++ /linux/fs/nilfs2/btree.c
@@ -558 +558 @@
-	if (level < minlevel || nilfs_btree_node_get_nchildren(node) <= 0)
+	if (level < minlevel)
@@ -559,0 +560,2 @@
+	if (nilfs_btree_node_get_nchildren(node) <= 0)
+		return -EINVAL;

--- /linux/fs/nilfs2/btree.c
+++ /linux/fs/nilfs2/btree.c
@@ -561 +561,6 @@
-		return -EINVAL;
+		/*
+		 * If the root is not at the bottom (minlevel) and has no children,
+		 * the tree structure is inconsistent because we cannot traverse
+		 * down to the requested level.
+		 */
+		return (level > minlevel) ? -EINVAL : -ENOENT;
